title: finding(layout): the mobile tab bar (`bottom_nav`) ignores `order`, so its tabs come out in authored order and the five-tab cap keeps the wrong five; the family closure for "the tab bar answers differently from the sidebar"
body:
Filing-gate category: **① a defect, class (a)**. `reach:` the published export `AppSchemaRenderer` (`@object-ui/layout`, registered as the SDUI node `app-schema-renderer`) with `mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'`, measured through the real component at objectui `main` `8673402` by the objectui#11362 dev, from the dev report on objectui#11362, `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (PR objectui#11393). The PR's ACCEPT `5936733215` judged it fileable. Reader who acts: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42`). ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedupe: the 600 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #3162, updated since 2026-09-28T06:45Z), were listed via REST and grepped locally for `MobileBottomNav` / `bottom_nav` / `mobile tab bar` near `order` / `sort`. That gave 3 hits, none about order: PR objectui#11393 (the entry-set half), objectui#11211 (the href half, closed) and PR objectui#11186 (labels, closed). As a control, 5 items mention `MobileBottomNav` / `bottom_nav`, so the grep reaches the family.

## Measured

`AppSchemaRenderer` with `mobileNavMode: 'bottom_nav'` and two entries written `Zeta` (`order: 2`) then `Ypsilon` (`order: 1`):

| surface | drawn order |
|:--|:--|
| sidebar (`NavigationRenderer`) | `Ypsilon`, `Zeta` (sorted by `order`) |
| mobile tab bar (`MobileBottomNav`) | `Zeta`, `Ypsilon` (authored order) |

With more than five entries the bar's five-tab cap therefore keeps the first five by **authored position**, not the five the sidebar puts first. `order` is a spec-declared navigation key.

## The cause (read at source)

- `NavigationRenderer` sorts top-level items and each group's children by `order`.
- `MobileBottomNav`'s `collectLeaves` (`packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx`) flattens and, after PR objectui#11393, guards the entries, but never sorts them.

## The family and why this is its closure card

"The tab bar answers differently from the sidebar" has two members repaired:
- objectui#11211: the hrefs and the active tab, PR objectui#11359;
- objectui#11362: which entries are drawn, PR objectui#11393.

`order` is the third, and the first measured one left. So this card covers the whole family, not only `order`.
- **Enumeration pin:** the fix lists every per-entry input the sidebar reads (`order`, the guard, href / active, label, icon, badge, and any others found), and pins each one through the real `AppSchemaRenderer` as either shared with the bar or deliberately bar-specific, with the reason.
- Members found during that enumeration are fixed under this card, not filed separately.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- The bar orders its entries by the sidebar's own sort, shared rather than copied (the objectui#11362 rule: ⛔ no second copy of a sidebar rule). Fixing it in place needs either a second copy of the sort or a new shared export. A new export of `@object-ui/layout` widens its published entry point (`packages/layout/src/index.ts` re-exports `NavigationRenderer` wholesale), which is a `Clause-②` question the claim answers.
- The cap applies after the sort, so the five tabs are the sidebar's first five visible entries.
- **Pins:** the table above with an ablation; a six-entry case where `order` decides which five show; the authored-order control when no entry carries `order`.

Dedupe words: `MobileBottomNav order` · `bottom_nav tab order` · `mobile tab bar sort weight` · `tab bar sidebar divergence family`
